status: exact classical decomposition and quadratic pole census for the fixed-norm two-derivative MacDowell-Mansouri/Stelle-West branch plus its minimal selector-covariant torsion-square deformation

conventions.warning: overall signs change with curvature and internal-metric conventions; all relative coefficients below use the displayed definitions

stelleWestAction.selector: V^A V_A=sigma ell^2, enforced by a Lagrange multiplier
stelleWestAction.covariantAction: S_SW=ell/(8 kappa) integral epsilon_{ABCDE} V^E F^{AB} wedge F^{CD}
stelleWestAction.gaugeFixedAction: S_MM=ell^2/(8 kappa) integral epsilon_{abcd} F^{ab} wedge F^{cd}

exactDecomposition.identity: epsilon F F=epsilon R R+2 ell^{-2} epsilon R e e+ell^{-4} epsilon e e e e

terms.name: Einstein-Cartan
terms.form: epsilon_{abcd} e^a wedge e^b wedge R^{cd}

terms.name: cosmological
terms.form: epsilon_{abcd} e^a wedge e^b wedge e^c wedge e^d

minimalBranchPoleCensus.connectionEquationInVacuum: epsilon_{abcd} e^c wedge T^d=0, hence T^a=0 for an invertible coframe
minimalBranchPoleCensus.reducedAction: Einstein-Hilbert with Lambda=-3/ell^2 plus the Euler boundary/topological invariant
minimalBranchPoleCensus.adsForm: (box+2/ell^2) h^{TT}_{mu nu}=0; the curvature shift is the AdS massless representation, not a Fierz-Pauli mass
minimalBranchPoleCensus.flatLimitSaturatedExchange: [T_{mu nu}T^{mu nu}-(1/2)T^2]/(M_Pl^2 p^2) for a conserved source

minimalSelectorCovariantDeformation.definition: mathcalT^A=F^{AB}V_B and S_lambda=S_SW+lambda M_Pl^2 integral mathcalT^A wedge star mathcalT_A
minimalSelectorCovariantDeformation.unitaryGauge: mathcalT^a=+/-T^a and the deformation is lambda M_Pl^2 integral T^a wedge star T_a
minimalSelectorCovariantDeformation.componentNormalization: the non-topological density is (M_Pl^2/2) sqrt(-g) [R(omega)+lambda T_{mu nu rho}T^{mu nu rho}-2 Lambda]
minimalSelectorCovariantDeformation.reasonForChoice: it is local, parity-even, quadratic, selector-covariant before unitary gauge, and adds no curvature-squared derivative

torsionDecomposition.formula: T_{mu nu rho}=(1/3)(T_nu g_{mu rho}-T_rho g_{mu nu})-(1/6)epsilon_{mu nu rho sigma}S^sigma+q_{mu nu rho}
torsionDecomposition.constraints: q^nu_{ mu nu}=0 and epsilon^{mu nu rho sigma}q_{mu nu rho}=0
torsionDecomposition.scalarCurvatureIdentityModuloBoundary: R(omega)=R(LC)-(4/3)T_mu T^mu+(1/24)S_mu S^mu+(1/2)q_{mu nu rho}q^{mu nu rho}
torsionDecomposition.torsionNormIdentity: T_{mu nu rho}T^{mu nu rho}=(2/3)T_mu T^mu-(1/6)S_mu S^mu+q_{mu nu rho}q^{mu nu rho}

minimalSelectorCovariantDeformation.genericDecision: for lambda not in {-1/2,1/4,2}, all 24 vacuum torsion components are algebraic and vanish; integrating them out leaves the same two graviton helicities and no auxiliary pole
minimalSelectorCovariantDeformation.exceptionalDecision: at lambda=-1/2,1/4,2 one irreducible algebraic Hessian block loses rank; without an added gauge symmetry or higher-order constraint analysis this is a strong-coupling/underdetermination stop, not evidence for a propagating massless mode
minimalSelectorCovariantDeformation.healthClassification: no torsion propagator denominator exists in this action class, so its torsion blocks are neither healthy massive particles nor ghosts/tachyons; those labels require a kinetic pole. The graviton is healthy when M_Pl^2>0

selectorCount.decision: the fixed-norm Stelle-West selector is a compensator and supplies no radial scalar pole; a softened norm and its kinetic term define a different action class

exhaustionAndStopRules: STOP the minimal branch if M_Pl^2<=0 because the massless spin-2 residue has the wrong sign or vanishes
STOP at lambda in {-1/2,1/4,2} until the nonlinear constraint algebra resolves the degenerate torsion block
DO NOT call an algebraic Hessian eigenvalue a particle mass; no p^2 dependence means no pole
DO NOT infer a torsion mass gap from this deformation: generic torsion is auxiliary and exceptional torsion is degenerate

To make torsion propagate one must add derivative-producing invariants, normally curvature-squared or an independent selector kinetic/radial sector; that is outside this exhausted two-derivative fixed-norm class and requires a fresh spin-parity residue analysis

Any enlarged branch must retain exactly two healthy massless graviton helicities, recover the Einstein and Lense-Thirring infrared response, and reject every negative-residue or negative-mass-squared physical pole
decision: The explicit minimal Spin(2,3) action succeeds as a reformulation of GR, not as a source of a selectively gapped extra spectrum. Its smallest selector-covariant torsion-square deformation changes only algebraic constraints. The earlier abstract healthy auxiliary projectors are therefore not realized by this action class.
